summary.one_liner: Extopus is an aggregating web front end that pulls data from several existing monitoring systems into a single modern interface via a plug-in system.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Extopus as an aggregator sitting in front of a range of monitoring tools such as MRTG, Nagios, Cacti, Ganglia, Torrus, OpenNMS, Munin and collectd. Its plug-in system is the stated way to bring data from several systems into one Extopus instance. It can be connected to an authentication and authorization provider so that only a subset of information is shown, which the README suggests for customer portals and other limited-access setups. The README is a short introduction and defers details to the project documentation, so specific features beyond this are not described here.
use_cases: unified dashboard across several monitoring tools
customer-facing monitoring portal with restricted data
consolidating MRTG, Nagios, Cacti or Munin data
notable: Aggregates data from many existing monitoring systems rather than replacing them
Plug-in system for integrating additional data sources
Optional authentication and authorization provider integration for restricted views
Targets customer portals and limited-access scenarios
caveats: README is a brief introduction; installation and setup are deferred to external documentation not included in the README
Authentication integration is optional and requires a separate provider
